questions.question: Dr. Samira receives a complaint from a patient regarding an unjustified fee overcharge. According to Article 30 of the Code of Ethics, what is Dr. Samira's first obligation?
options: Ignore the patient's complaint
Provide clear explanations about the amount of fees
Immediately refer the matter to the disciplinary council
Offer a partial refund
questions.explanation: Article 30 states that the dental surgeon is never entitled to refuse to provide explanations to their patient regarding the amount of their fees.

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a dispute with a colleague regarding a patient they are treating together. According to Article 48 of the Code of Ethics, what is the first step to take?
options: Immediately take the matter to court
Attempt direct conciliation with the colleague
Post the dispute on social media
Change practice
questions.explanation: Article 48 requires dental surgeons to maintain good collegial relations and to first attempt reconciliation before any other action.

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a conflict with her assistant regarding working conditions. According to the Labor Code, what is the assistant's first recourse?
options: Refer the matter to the dental council
Refer the matter to the labor inspectorate
File a criminal complaint
Change profession
questions.explanation: Conflicts between employer and employee fall under the Labor Code. The labor inspectorate is the competent authority for mediation and control.

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a dispute with his landlord regarding a rent increase. According to Law 49-16 on commercial leases, what is the rule regarding rent revision?
options: The rent is fixed definitively upon signing the lease
Rent revision is subject to Law No. 07-03
The landlord can increase the rent every month
The tenant has no recourse
questions.explanation: Law 49-16 provides that rent revision is subject to the provisions of Law No. 07-03 relating to the revision of rent amounts for professional premises.

questions.question: Dr. Samira disagrees with her colleague on an orthodontic treatment. According to Article 56 of the Code of Ethics, how should the consulting dentist behave?
options: They may continue treatment without consulting the colleague
They must not continue treatment unless expressly requested by the patient
They may impose their treatment
They must ignore the colleague's opinion
questions.explanation: Article 56 states that the consulting dental surgeon must not, unless expressly requested by the patient, continue the treatment required by the patient's condition when such treatment falls within the competence of the treating dental surgeon.

questions.question: Dr. Malika is confronted with a patient who refuses to pay their fees. According to Article 6 of the Code of Ethics, what is the fundamental principle regarding payment?
options: Payment must be made by the insurance company only
Direct payment of fees by the patient to the dentist is the principle
The patient can pay whenever they wish
The dentist must offer payment facilities
questions.explanation: Article 6 provides for direct payment of fees by the patient to the dental surgeon as a fundamental principle of dental practice.

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a conflict with her assistant who disclosed confidential patient information. According to Article 4 of the Code of Ethics, what is the situation?
options: Only the dentist is responsible for professional confidentiality
The assistant is also bound by professional confidentiality
The patient has no recourse
The disclosure is excusable
questions.explanation: Article 4 states that the dental surgeon must ensure that the persons assisting them are informed of their obligations regarding professional confidentiality and comply with them.

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a dispute with his landlord regarding the condition of the premises. According to Law 49-16, what document must be prepared when the premises are handed over?
options: A simple receipt
A descriptive inventory of the premises
An employment contract
A certificate of good character
questions.explanation: Article 3 of Law 49-16 provides that a descriptive inventory of the premises must be prepared upon handover, to serve as evidence between the parties.

questions.question: Dr. Samira is in conflict with a colleague who made disparaging remarks about her work. According to Article 50 of the Code of Ethics, what is the rule?
options: Criticism between colleagues is permitted
It is forbidden to slander a colleague or speak ill of them
One may criticize a colleague privately
Remarks are acceptable if justified
questions.explanation: Article 50 forbids slandering a colleague, speaking ill of them, or repeating remarks likely to harm them in the exercise of their profession.

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a patient who threatens to file a complaint about an aesthetic result they consider unsatisfactory. According to ethical principles, what should Dr. Malika's first attitude be?
options: Ignore the patient
Listen to the patient and attempt an explanation
Immediately refer the matter to court
Refuse all contact with the patient
questions.explanation: The first ethical reflex is listening and attempting to explain. Communication is the basis of conflict prevention and resolution.

questions.question: Dr. Samira has an employee who does not respect working hours. According to the Labor Code, what is the first measure to take?
options: Immediately dismiss the employee
Initiate a progressive disciplinary procedure
Reduce their salary
Ignore the problem
questions.explanation: The Labor Code provides for a gradation of disciplinary sanctions. The first measure must be proportionate to the fault committed.

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a dispute with his landlord regarding renovation work. According to Law 49-16, who must bear the rental charges if the lease does not specify the allocation?
options: The tenant
The owner
Charges are considered included in the rent
Charges are shared 50%
questions.explanation: Article 5 of Law 49-16 provides that in the absence of stipulation as to which party bears the charges, they are considered included in the rent.

questions.question: Dr. Samira disagrees with a colleague on sharing a patient. According to Article 51 of the Code of Ethics, what is prohibited?
options: Collaboration between colleagues
Poaching or attempting to poach patients
Exchanging patients
Consultation between colleagues
questions.explanation: Article 51 formally prohibits poaching or attempting to poach patients.

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a complaint from a patient who feels they were not informed of the risks of a treatment. According to Article 24 of the Code of Ethics, what is the dentist's obligation?
options: Not to inform the patient to avoid worrying them
To provide informed care in accordance with scientific data
To let the patient find out for themselves
To inform only the family
questions.explanation: Article 24 requires the dentist to provide informed care in accordance with established scientific knowledge, which implies prior information to the patient.

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a conflict with her assistant who refused a dangerous task. According to the Labor Code, what is the assistant's right?
options: They must obey their employer
They have the right to refuse a dangerous task if safety conditions are not met
They can be dismissed for insubordination
The refusal is unjustified
questions.explanation: Any employee has the right to refuse a task they consider dangerous to their health or safety if protection conditions are not met.

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a dispute with his landlord regarding lease renewal. According to Law 49-16, after how long of occupancy does the tenant benefit from renewal rights?
options: 6 months
1 year
2 years
5 years
questions.explanation: Article 4 of Law 49-16 provides that the tenant benefits from lease renewal when they have had consecutive enjoyment of the premises for at least two years.

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a patient who complains of excessive noise in the practice. According to the Labor Code (Article 281), what is Dr. Samira's obligation?
options: Nothing, noise is inevitable
Ensure that the premises provide adequate hygiene and safety conditions
Install air conditioning
Provide hearing protection
questions.explanation: Article 281 requires the employer to ensure that the workplace provides the hygiene and safety conditions necessary for the health of employees.

questions.question: Dr. Malika disagrees with a colleague who refuses to share information about a patient they are treating together. According to Article 53 of the Code of Ethics, what is the rule?
options: The colleague has the right to remain silent
The colleague must provide useful information in the patient's interest
The patient must be excluded from follow-up
The dispute must be taken to court
questions.explanation: Article 53 encourages collaboration and exchange of information between colleagues in the patient's interest, particularly in cases of shared follow-up.

questions.question: Dr. Samira has an employee who committed a serious misconduct. According to Article 61 of the Labor Code, what are the consequences for the employee?
options: They may be dismissed without notice or compensation
They are entitled to severance pay
They must be immediately reinstated
They cannot be dismissed
questions.explanation: Article 61 of the Labor Code provides that in the event of serious misconduct, the employee may be dismissed without notice or compensation or payment of damages.

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a dispute with a patient who signed a receipt for final settlement. According to Article 75 of the Labor Code, can this receipt be contested?
options: No, the signature is final
Yes, it can be denounced within 60 days of signing
Yes, within 30 days
No, the receipt is irrevocable
questions.explanation: Article 75 of the Labor Code provides that the receipt for final settlement can be denounced within 60 days following the date of its signature.

questions.question: Dr. Samira wishes to refer a complaint against a colleague to the disciplinary council. According to Article 48, what is the procedure?
options: Refer directly to the council without notice
First attempt direct conciliation with the colleague
Publish the complaint in the press
Wait a year
questions.explanation: Article 48 requires first attempting reconciliation with the colleague. If the attempt fails, one may then inform the president of the national council of the order.

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a conflict with his landlord who refuses to carry out necessary work. According to Law 49-16, what is the owner's obligation?
options: Nothing, work is the tenant's responsibility
The owner is required to maintain the premises
The tenant must do the work at their own expense
Work must be shared 50%
questions.explanation: The owner is obliged to provide decent premises and maintain them, in accordance with the lease and the law.

questions.question: Dr. Samira is in conflict with her assistant who claims a bonus she believes is due. According to the Labor Code, what is the assistant's recourse?
options: Refer the matter to the disciplinary council
Refer the matter to the commercial court
Refer the matter to the labor court
Go on strike
questions.explanation: Disputes relating to salary and bonus payments fall within the jurisdiction of the labor court.

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a patient who insulted them during consultation. According to the Code of Ethics, how should they react?
options: Respond in the same tone
Remain calm and attempt to de-escalate the situation
Immediately expel the patient
Immediately file a complaint
questions.explanation: Professionalism requires remaining calm, even in the face of an insulting patient, and attempting to de-escalate the conflict through dialogue.

questions.question: Dr. Samira finds that her landlord has sold the premises to a third party. According to Law 49-16, what happens to Dr. Samira's lease?
options: The lease is automatically terminated
The lease continues to have effect between the tenant and the new owner
The new owner can evict the tenant without notice
The tenant must renegotiate the lease
questions.explanation: The sale of the premises does not terminate the lease. The new owner is bound to respect the commitments of the previous landlord.

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a dispute with a patient regarding the absence of a prior estimate for an expensive treatment. According to Article 30 of the Code of Ethics, what is the dentist's obligation?
options: No estimate obligation is provided for
Prepare a written estimate for any treatment of high cost
An oral estimate is sufficient
The patient must request an estimate
questions.explanation: Article 30 provides that when the dental surgeon is led to propose a treatment of high cost, they prepare a written estimate which they give to their patient.
